title: Three Tips for Twilight Painting
content: Three tips for painting twilight streetscapes in opaques (gouache or casein):1. Bring a battery-operatedLED lightso you can see what you're doing.2. When you start, try to anticipate where the scene will be at peak color, and aim for that in your layin.3. Paint a big yellow area under windows first and then paint the dark areas over them.----"Gouache in the Wild"at Gumroad$14.95GurneyJourney YouTube channelMy Public FacebookpageGurneyJourney onPinterestJamesGurney Art onInstagram@GurneyJourney on Twitter
